protocol.epoch_selection: Same per-class minimax FNR/FPR in all three validation domains, then sum of target rates; full-photo grid1 only.
protocol.small_region_policy: Existing DACL positives with native polygon area below 1% after 640 resize: crack93, spall105,198class-photo rows; photo miss counts, not precision localization or198necessarilyuniquephotos.
protocol.source_selection: Original TRAIN labels/masks/crops, source sampler, photo/pixel/auxiliary weights and initialization fixed; no new data, mining, ranking or relabeling.
protocol.strict_target: Every source crack/spalling FNR and FPR strictly below .05; not aggregate wrong-photo fraction or industrial field performance.
protocol.source_test_policy: No test inference or test result use unless frozen strict validation target passes. Existing source holdouts are not fresh factory validation.
protocol.deployment: Research nomination does not automatically replace facility-validation-v2 or its app profile.
protocol.interval_policy: Wilson95 descriptive only; correlated photos and repeated validation selection limit interpretation.
protocol.stop: Complete one six-epoch pair; no validation-driven K/gate/recipe retries or extra epochs; no5% guarantee.
protocol.label_review_policy: Original TRAIN review preparation only; no expert corrections available, no labels changed. Existing review package may be an older initializer and is distinguished.

spatial_manifest_audit.policy: Only DACL train/new Dam train/CODEBRIM train and their TRAIN detail children; source polygons/masks, negatives from asserted absent classes; CODEBRIM positives have no invented pixel regions; 8x8 any-positive cells; photo labels unchanged
spatial_manifest_audit.scope: Spatial loss supervision, not full-resolution segmentation evaluation or field localization accuracy

matched_pair_conditions.selection: Minimax per-class FNR/FPR in all three validation domains; no pixel accuracy or test used for selection
matched_pair_conditions.loss: Masked weighted focal photo presence + masked focal 8x8-cell source segmentation + .5 positive-class Dice + 0.5 masked original-DACL photo-tag focal
matched_pair_conditions.total_loss_formula: Recorded base photo/pixel/auxiliary loss + target_ranking.weight * within-source full-photo ranking loss

target_ranking.scope: Original verified TRAIN full photos only; same-source same-class asserted positive versus negative pairs; crops and unknowns excluded
target_ranking.formula: Mean softplus(negative_logit-positive_logit) within each contributing source-class group, then equal group mean; float32

strict_target: Every original-source crack/spalling FNR/FPR strictly below.05; not whole-app or factory accuracy
interval_policy: Wilson95 descriptive only; independence unverified and repeated validation selection prevents confirmatory interpretation

technical_verification_summary.augmentation_replay_scope: Three batches over eight original TRAIN photos with four workers; full-epoch augmented tensor equality not measured; actual full-epoch row order checked separately

facility-presence-target-context-control.scope: Observed training plus epoch validation time and CUDA allocated peak; not reserved memory or mobile cost

facility-presence-target-context-pool.scope: Observed training plus epoch validation time and CUDA allocated peak; not reserved memory or mobile cost

facility-presence-target-context-control.scope: Actual optimizer post-step hook counts; skips are diagnostic, not an added performance gate

facility-presence-target-context-pool.scope: Actual optimizer post-step hook counts; skips are diagnostic, not an added performance gate

limitations: Single seed; repeated original-source validation epoch/threshold selection
Top32/top256 are map-logit order statistics, not spatial adjacency or scene semantics
Seven signed zero gates add no new gold photo/pixel labels
198 small-area class-photo cases may share photos across labels
Source full rows include publisher CODEBRIM patches; crop rows add no independent photographs
Target negative does not mean general safe/normal facility ground truth
Dam intact-category conversion follows author semantics, not independent spall masks or field expert validation
Original labels/masks preserved; unknowns not filled negative and errors not excluded
Bridge/dam validation does not measure industrial field accuracy
Research nomination tolerates predeclared regressions and does not deploy the model
Equal sampled row order does not imply equal actual elapsed cost, CUDA allocation or AMP update count
